_comment: G4 v0.1 acceptance gate fixture — Mode behavior fidelity (Option A reinterpretation).
_design: 10 Goal Contracts spanning Exam (4), Growth (4), Hybrid (2). For each, the runner generates a lesson plan and scores whether mode-specific signals appear in plan.objective + plan.path + plan.micro_proof.
_pass_criteria: ≥9/10 contracts produce a plan that aligns with their chosen mode (combined keyword + LLM-tagger score ≥ 60).
